_comment: events-qr-checkin (REQ-EQC-001). An accepted registration carries a check-in code, set by larpinq (RegistrationService on acceptance, GiveAcceptedRegistrationsACheckinCode for those accepted before). Only game masters and the registration's player read it; nobody but a game master may change it.

checkinCode.title: Check-in code
checkinCode.description: The code a steward scans or types at the door, set by larpinq when the registration is accepted. Kept when the registration moves to another player.
